Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

In addition to the above, the employee will be entitled for an additional fare by the entitled class for self for both onward and return journeys, if he has to leave his family behind due to non-availability of Government accommodation at the new place of posting. Officials who could not take family members along with him / her on their second trip due to genuine reasons are also entitled to an additional to and fro fare by the entitled class. - GIO (5), Para. VI, SR 116.
